briefing.headline: Harbour Town dominate proceedings by pressing high and attacking down their left; Kestrel have had rare moments down their right but are overwhelmed in territory and chance creation.

working.text: Harbour are controlling the game and territory: their field tilt is 78.2% and they have 55.2% possession.
They press aggressively (PPDA 3.1) and win the ball very high (turnover height 54.8 m), producing 19 high regains which feed attacking chances.
Harbour are creating the better openings: 0.75 xG with seven shots and three on target.

not_working.text: Harbour are heavily channelled to the left for entries—70.6% of their final-third entries come down the left—making their attacking patterns predictable.
Their press intensity may be hard to sustain: the system shows a very low PPDA (3.1) which typically rises as legs tire.

predictions.claim: Harbour will look to reduce Kestrel's influence down Kestrel's right by forcing Kestrel to attack narrower, cutting Kestrel's right-channel entries by at least 30%.
Harbour's press intensity will ease and their PPDA will increase by at least 20% as they manage legs.
Harbour will push to keep attacking volume up and increase their final-third entries by at least 20%.

working.text: Kestrel have occasional success attacking the right: 58.3% of their entries come down the right flank.
They remain relatively compact out of possession with a lower defensive line (22.8 m) which limits space behind them.
Kestrel's progressive passing tally (68) and some individual passing combinations show they can progress the ball even if chances are few (xG 0.04).

not_working.text: Kestrel are being overrun in territory and chance creation: field tilt for Harbour is 78.2% and Harbour have 0.75 xG versus Kestrel's 0.04.
They are losing the ball high up—Kestrel have only three high regains while Harbour have nineteen—and are being pressed lightly (PPDA 11.2) compared with Harbour's intense press.

predictions.claim: Gregor Molina will instruct Kestrel to sit one midfielder deeper to disrupt Harbour's high regains, cutting Harbour's high_regains by at least 30%.
Kestrel will try to regain more control of possession and push for at least a 10% rise in their possession share.
Kestrel will try to protect their right flank less vulnerably by reducing Harbour's left-channel entries by at least 30%.
